content:
maria: Heads-up — quick all-hands this Thursday 10:00 AM PT in the main room. Short, focused: platform snapshot + a couple launch callouts + security flags. Please drop any Qs here or add to the form if you want them anonymized: https://forms.gle/xyz123

maria: Proposed agenda (30m):
- 10:00 — 10:05: quick product/launch highlights (Grant)
- 10:05 — 10:12: infra/latency & cost update (Sasha)
- 10:12 — 10:18: security/compliance callouts (Ira)
- 10:18 — 10:25: rollout plan + support expectations (Oliver)
- 10:25 — 10:30: open Q&A + follow-ups

grant: adding — well call out the feature gating approach and canary metrics. Will show one slide with the rollout cadence and the fallback plan.

sasha: FYI Ill include a short chart of median p95 token latency for the last 7 days and a note on batching changes. If anyone has a specific query you want covered, tag me.

ira: security update will mention the new policy for key rotation and the upcoming SOC audit prep. Not surfacing any incidents — just proactive posture items and what teams need to do.

oliver: logistics: hybrid meeting, recording enabled, captions on. If youre remote and need to speak, DM me and Ill queue you. Also please RSVP on calendar so we can order lunch for in-office folks. :pizza:

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: All-hands broadcast set for 2026-03-26T17:00:00Z. Auto-recording ON.

kyle: quick q — will the rollout callouts include rollback triggers (e.g., error rate > 5% or latency spike > 2x)?

grant: yes, will show explicit triggers and the runbook link. Plan is auto-fallback to model-v1 when we hit thresholds.

audrey: can we add a one-sentence blurb about on-call coverage during the launch window? want to make sure PTO folks are covered.

oliver: added — well publish coverage map post-call. If youre scheduled OOO, ping your backup in the thread.

maria: thanks all. One ask: if youve got a concise demo or slide <2 min, upload to the shared deck by Wednesday EOD. Well trim to keep it tight.

-- (post-call) --

grant: Recording + slides: https://drive.redwood/repo/allhands-2026-03-26-recording.mp4 and https://drive.redwood/repo/allhands-2026-03-26-slides.pdf

grant: TL;DR takeaways:
- launch: gradual 3-stage rollout, ~10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with canary checks
- fallback: model-v1 auto-fallback on latency or error thresholds
- infra: batching improvements reduced median token cost by ~8% last week
- security: key rotation automation scheduled for next Tuesday, SOC audit prep checklist shared with teams

sasha: action: infra to publish updated batching config by Monday. Owner: sasha.

ira: action: security to send the audit checklist and point-of-contact details. Owner: ira.

oliver: action: people-ops to publish the on-call coverage map and backup assignments. Owner: oliver.

kyle: thanks — all sounds good.

audrey: appreciated the short format — much easier to skim.

maria: excellent. If anything urgent comes up, escalate in #release-war-room. Otherwise well track the actions in the Ops board and follow up at next sync. :white_check_mark:
